employers.description: Flying Food Group is an airline catering company founded in 1983 that produces inflight meals and retail food products for major airlines and airport retail brands worldwide. Their Burlingame facility at 50 Adrian Ct serves as a Bay Area kitchen near SFO, one of 14 U.S. locations, producing both fresh onboard meals and shelf-stable MAP (modified atmosphere packaging) products. Culinary production, food safety, and logistics roles are central to the local operation.
employers.name: REMOVE

employers.description: 37 North Restaurant & Bar is a California-inspired gastropub located in the lobby of the DoubleTree by Hilton San Francisco Airport at 835 Airport Blvd, Burlingame. The menu is built around sustainably sourced, locally and regionally grown ingredients — seasonal produce from small farms, artisan beers, and hand-crafted cocktails — served for breakfast and dinner in an indoor/outdoor setting with courtyard fire pits. Front-of-house, kitchen, and bar roles draw from the San Mateo County hospitality workforce near SFO.
employers.name: 37 North

employers.description: 3SIXTY Bar | Bistro | Market is the full-service dining venue at the Hyatt Regency San Francisco Airport in Burlingame, operating as three integrated concepts — a sit-down bistro, a full bar, and a grab-and-go market — open daily from 6 a.m. to midnight. The bistro serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner focused on locally sourced Northern California ingredients with rotating seasonal menus and a farm-to-table philosophy. It employs front- and back-of-house hospitality staff serving a primarily airport-adjacent traveler and business clientele.
employers.name: 3SIXTY Bistro

They offer catering services and gift cards, with locations across various neighborhoods.

employers.description: Jack's Restaurant & Bar is a family-owned American restaurant at 1750 S El Camino Real in San Mateo, open all day for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and a full bar program. The kitchen focuses on scratch-made comfort food with a Greek-American influence — burgers, hearty breakfasts, and large salads — drawing on the Marcovici family's heritage and California seasonal ingredients. Front-of-house and kitchen roles span line cooks, servers, and bartenders serving the Peninsula corridor.
employers.name: Jack's San Mateo

employers.description: Olive Garden is an Italian restaurant chain offering family-style dining, catering, and to-go services. It serves customers seeking Italian food through dine-in, pickup, and delivery options, with locations across the U.S. Key activities include preparing classic entrees, appetizers, desserts, and beverages.
employers.name: Olive Garden

employers.description: P.F. Chang's is a restaurant chain offering handcrafted Asian-inspired food for dine-in, to-go, and catering. They serve individual customers with lunch specials, dinner, and beverages, including a limited-time seasonal menu. Key activities include restaurant operations, reservations, and a rewards program.
employers.name: PF Chang's

employers.description: Pacific Catch is a California-born seafood restaurant serving fresh, sustainably sourced, and ocean-friendly seafood inspired by the Pacific. It operates across multiple locations in California, offering dine-in, catering, and online ordering, with a focus on a feel-good dining experience.
employers.name: Pacific Catch

employers.description: Steins Beer Garden in Mountain View, CA, offers 31 beers on tap, craft cocktails, and scratch-made New American Cuisine. It serves customers daily for lunch and dinner, providing dine-in, private events, catering, and online ordering for pick-up and delivery services.
employers.name: Steins Beer Garden

employers.description: The Fish Market is a California seafood restaurant group founded in 1976, operating two locations in San Diego and Del Mar, with an upscale sister concept (Top of the Market) co-located at the San Diego Harbor Drive site. Each location combines a full-service dining room specializing in fresh-caught and grilled seafood with a retail fish counter staffed by in-house specialists who advise on home preparation. The operation employs front-of-house, back-of-house, and kitchen staff across both sites.
employers.name: The Fish Market

employers.description: The Grill on the Alley is a steak house in San Jose, CA, offering a menu of food and beverages. It serves customers in the Bay Area region through dine-in, takeout, and catering services, including private dining options.

employers.description: Crowne Plaza Foster City-San Mateo is a 350-room full-service hotel operated under IHG's Crowne Plaza brand, situated on the San Francisco Peninsula between SFO (9 miles) and Silicon Valley, serving business and group travelers. The property offers 24,000 square feet of meeting space across 19 venues, two on-site restaurants (Café Florian and Clubhouse Bistro), and indoor and outdoor pools. Guest-facing and back-of-house roles span front desk, food and beverage, housekeeping, event services, and facilities maintenance.
employers.name: Crowne Plaza Foster City
